body.name: \(P^\star\)
body.construction: Under \(P^\star\), \((D,Z)\) takes \((0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)\) with probabilities \((2/25,9/20,9/25,11/100)\); \(Y\mid(D,Z)=(0,z)\) is uniform on \([0,1]\), \(Y\mid(D,Z)=(1,0)\) is \(\operatorname{Beta}(79,21)\), and \(Y\mid(D,Z)=(1,1)\) is \(\operatorname{Beta}(17,3)\)
